assessment: This important study combines single cell and single nucleus transcriptomics to two echinoderm embryos to identify embryonic cell types and assess cell type evolutionary novelties. The paper provides convincing pieces of evidence in regards to the sea star embryonic cell types and their relationship to the sea urchin ones, highlighting conserved, diverged as well as novel genetic programs operating during early echinoderm development. The work will be of broad interest to developmental and evolutionary biologists.
